# The menu

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/sli.py catalog-doc` from catalog/recipes/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every recipe is a ready-made SLI: what counts as a good event and what counts as a valid one.
Pick recipes in your `slo.yaml` by `id`. Status `draft` means the recipe has not yet been
checked against real data in our Datadog org; `verified` means it has.

Source: `apm` = needs Datadog APM on the service. `integration` = comes from a Datadog
integration, no code. `convention` = you emit the metric named in
[conventions.md](conventions.md).

## Availability

| Recipe | For | Source | Status | Modes | Params (required in bold) | What it measures |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `compute.ecs_availability` | compute, service | integration | draft | time_slice (default) | **ecs_cluster**, **ecs_service**, min_ratio=1 | Minutes in which an ECS service ran at least its desired task count (times min_ratio), divided by all minutes. |
| `datastore.availability` | datastore | apm | draft | events (default) | **db_service**, **operation** | Database queries that did not fail, as seen by the services calling the database, divided by all queries. |
| `dependency.availability` | service, job | convention | draft | events (default), time_slice | **dependency**, min_good_ratio=0.99 | Successful calls to one outbound dependency (API, MCP, vendor), divided by all calls to it. |
| `job.availability` | job, service | convention | draft | events (default) | **job** | Job runs that succeeded, divided by all job runs that finished. |
| `network.availability` | network | convention | draft | events (default) | **target** | Network probes that succeeded, divided by all probes sent to a target. |
| `queue.availability` | queue, service | convention | draft | events (default) | **destination** | Messages or pushes delivered, divided by all that finished (delivered, failed or dead-lettered). |
| `request.availability` | service | apm | draft | events (default), time_slice | **operation**, min_good_ratio=0.99 | Requests that did not fail, divided by all requests. |
| `storage.availability` | storage | convention | draft | events (default) | **volume** | Storage reads and writes that succeeded, divided by all reads and writes. |

## Latency

| Recipe | For | Source | Status | Modes | Params (required in bold) | What it measures |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `datastore.latency` | datastore | apm | draft | time_slice (default) | **db_service**, **operation**, **threshold_seconds**, percentile=p95 | Minutes in which database query latency, as seen by callers, stayed under the threshold, divided by all minutes. |
| `dependency.latency` | service, job | convention | draft | time_slice (default) | **dependency**, **threshold_seconds**, percentile=p95 | Minutes in which calls to one dependency stayed under the latency threshold, divided by all minutes. |
| `network.latency` | network | convention | draft | time_slice (default) | **target**, **threshold_seconds**, percentile=p95 | Minutes in which probe round-trip time stayed under the threshold, divided by all minutes. |
| `queue.latency` | queue, service | convention | draft | time_slice (default) | **destination**, **threshold_seconds**, percentile=p95 | Minutes in which delivery time (enqueue to delivered) stayed under the threshold, divided by all minutes. |
| `request.latency` | service | apm | draft | time_slice (default) | **operation**, **threshold_seconds**, percentile=p95 | Minutes in which request latency stayed under the threshold, divided by all minutes. |

## Freshness

| Recipe | For | Source | Status | Modes | Params (required in bold) | What it measures |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data.freshness` | job, service, datastore, storage | convention | draft | time_slice (default) | **dataset**, **max_age_seconds**, no_data_minutes=30 | Minutes in which a dataset was younger than the allowed age, divided by all minutes. |
| `datastore.aurora_replica_lag` | datastore | integration | draft | time_slice (default) | **cluster**, **max_lag_ms** | Minutes in which Aurora replica lag stayed under the threshold, divided by all minutes. |
| `queue.sqs_freshness` | queue | integration | draft | time_slice (default) | **queue**, **max_age_seconds** | Minutes in which the oldest message in an SQS queue was younger than the allowed age, divided by all minutes. |
